pages.title: about - quillstone-bio.test
pages.text:
Quillstone Bio develops enzyme therapies for rare diseases.
Quillstone Bio is headquartered in Zürich.
Quillstone Bio is not headquartered in Geneva.
Quillstone Bio is reportedly based in Basel.
Quillstone Bio is registered as Quillstone Biosciences Ltd.
Quillstone Bio was formerly registered as Quillstone Bio Ltd.

pages.title: people - quillstone-bio.test
pages.text:
Former CEO Rosa Alvarez left Quillstone Bio in 2020.
Wen Zhao has been chief executive of Quillstone Bio since 2022.

pages.title: funding - quillstone-bio.test
pages.text:
Quillstone Bio was founded in 2011 and raised $4M in 2013.
Quillstone Bio is in talks to raise $40M.
Quillstone Bio raised €30 million in 2019.
Quillstone Bio plans to raise $60 million next year.

pages.title: staff - quillstone-bio.test
pages.text: Quillstone Bio employs 85 people in 3 labs.
